_readme: Single source of truth for every liquid-glass / chroma control in the frontend.
liquidGlass.<preset>: optics passed to useLiquidGlass (via src/lib/glassPresets.ts).
refraction  - false skips the SVG refraction filter entirely (plain tinted glass, much cheaper on big moving panels).
scale       - displacement strength; negative = magnifying bulge (-60 subtle ... -180 dramatic).
chroma      - per-channel scale stagger = the prism / colour-fringe amount. 0 turns it off.
mapBlur     - curvature of the bulge (small = hard rim, large = dome).
blur        - backdrop blur in px behind the glass. 0 keeps what is behind it perfectly sharp.
fallbackBlur- frosted blur used on Safari/Firefox where refraction is unsupported.
dressing.<preset>: tint / highlight / shadow, applied as CSS variables on :root (live-updates on save).
Preset (optics) changes apply to newly mounted elements - reload the page after editing them.
welcomeBackground.tint: the dark overlay above the welcome page background video. enabled=false removes it completely.
